ownerSourceReceipt.exactSourceBlock:
how many tokens are you using to wait for the chat response compared to wwen you actually work?
add that to the codex supervisor workflow, continue

exactIssue: Compact polling constrains context growth but does not separately report waiting resource use versus substantive execution resource use, so the owner cannot audit whether supervision overhead is proportionate.

relevantRule.section: 11. Continue automatically and keep the reasoning handoff live
relevantRule.excerpt: Intermediate polls return only PENDING or READY plus request/response identity and retry metadata.

observedOrHypotheticalFailure: A worker can comply with constant-size polling while still hiding cumulative wait cost or comparing guessed token totals, preventing an evidence-based wait-versus-work efficiency audit.
proposedChange: Add separate exact-token accounting when runtime telemetry exists, byte/call-count fallback when it does not, an explicit prohibition on estimated token totals, and a rule that accounting cannot delay response import or execution resumption.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Report an informal percentage from conversation length.
alternativesConsidered.rejectedBecause: It would be an unverifiable estimate and could confuse context size with billed or generated tokens.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Keep only the existing constant-size poll regression.
alternativesConsidered.rejectedBecause: It proves bounded per-poll context but does not expose cumulative wait cost relative to execution.

risks: Telemetry fields could become busywork if they block resumption.
Byte ratios are only a fallback proxy and must not be labeled token ratios.
workerRecommendation: Adopt the minimal schema, bootstrap rule, and regression while keeping accounting outside compact poll envelopes and nonblocking for task execution.
workerUncertainty: The current runtime does not expose exact per-phase token telemetry to this controller, so this run can report only that exact token totals are unavailable.
decisionThatCanChange: Supervisor handoff telemetry schema and owner-visible supervision efficiency reporting.
